scope: Audited HY3 method port; original-paper reproduction NOT established
supersedes: Withdraws complete labels and unvalidated deltas in commit f0a0ff1

protocol.paired_eval: Five independent runs over the full fixed official test set; five repetitions are not pass^5

metrics.MSR: mean task success rate across runs
metrics.pass^5: fraction of tasks successful in all five runs
metrics.pass@5: fraction successful at least once in five runs

protocol.paper_models: solver gpt-5.4-mini default effort; auxiliaries gpt-5.4 high; tau2 user gpt-4.1-2025-04-14
protocol.hy3_models: All model roles use HY3 Taiji only; solver high requested; tau2 user and NL evaluator changed to HY3
protocol.execution: any4 CPU only; no WorkBuddy API for experiments
protocol.implementation: Pinned DAEDALUS; ACE/ExpeL are its references reimplementations, not original author repos
protocol.acceptance: Official per-run task IDs + five runs + score/trace agreement + SHA-bound terminal markers; old artifacts not auto-promoted
protocol.runtime_fix: Explicit runtime_safety shim; real no-completion stall, exception propagation, CPU embedding; no locked vendor edits
